[Intro]
[Female Vocal, airy whisper, sparse pads, water-drop pluck]
yesterday blooming in new light
yesterday on the palm
sleeve keeps blooming

[Verse 1]

low new, ember stays
linger after light
hold yesterday in the cloth
window holds blooming

[Hook]
[Female Vocal, staccato phonetic, hard stops]
late glow
yesterday blooming in new light
late glow

[Chorus]
[Female Vocal, percussive spoken, groove-synced]
yesterday on the palm
sleeve keeps blooming
low new, ember stays
late glow

[Verse 2]
[Female Vocal, raspy airy, clipped consonants]
linger after light
hold yesterday in the cloth
window holds blooming
new on the hour

[Rap]
[Female Vocal, low close breathy rap cadence]
yesterday in the palm, late low
blooming in the sleeve, late low
new in the ember, late low
light in the linger, late low
yesterday in the cloth, late low
blooming in the window, late low

[Bridge]
[Female Vocal, sparse, intimate, pads only]
yesterday blooming in new light
new on the hour
late glow

[Final]
[Female Vocal, raspy spoken, hard phrase stops]
late glow
yesterday on the palm
linger after light
late glow

[Outro]
[Female Vocal, last syllable extended, raspy fade]
late glow
sleeve keeps blooming
pkg.sunoStyle: Groovy airy electro-pop with groove. Minimal, rhythm-driven, laid-back, subtly sensual. Tempo: 92 BPM, slight swing, behind-the-beat feel. Drums: kick on 1 and 3, ghost kicks between; snare/clap on 2 and 4. Arrangement: resonant sub bass follows kick, pulsing pads drive rhythm, water-drop pluck for melody. Sound: clean airy mix, controlled reverb, soft delay, wide stereo. Vocal: female, distinct raspy, airy-textured, mature tone. Texture: pronounced rasp, audible vocal fry, slight grit. Style: spoken word, rap cadence. NOT singing. Rules: no melody, no sustain. Each word separate. Hard stop each phrase. Timing: lock to beat grid, words align with kick/snare hits. Phrasing: choppy, staccato, clipped, groove-synced. Delivery: percussive, consonant-driven. Pitch: near-monotone. Flow: relaxed, slightly behind snare but locked. Ending: last syllable extended, raspy breathy fade with fry. Core: drum-locked spoken vocal over bass, pads, water pluck.
